entries.en: To covet another's goods; greedy, avaricious.
entries.notes: H 栏字符有 [疑]（妬/婪），R 栏「lân: chǔ」似含两读，故降为中等。

entries.en: To covet; to scheme greedily for gain.
entries.notes: R 栏 mēn 与「謀」官话常音不合，M 栏多出 jān 一音节，释义依 H 栏定夺。

entries.en: To desire in one's heart; to long for inwardly.
To covet; to grab greedily, avaricious.
entries.notes: L 栏 gmal. 为 generalmente 之缩写，义「泛言之」。

entries.zh: 侵吞他人财物；如噬人般咬噬吞占。
entries.en: To prey on others and strip them of their goods; to bite and devour another's property.
entries.notes: R 栏 xû 与「噬」常音不合，但 H/M 与 L 栏「quitar y chupar lo ajeno」相合。

entries.zh: 贪财的；只认钱（眼里只有钱）。
entries.notes: L 栏「arador avaro nancip」残损难读，释义据 H/M「係是錢」。

entries.en: To take graft; (of a mandarin) to covet illicit gains.
entries.notes: L 栏「lah tienda y qui palla」残损，R 栏有 [疑]，释义据 H/M「貪贓」。

entries.en: Excessively covetous; insatiably longing for things.
entries.notes: H「戀戀年」字面义费解（R 作 nièn，疑即「念」），依 L 栏「过分贪婪」定夺。

entries.zh: 抢钱；什么都想要（贪得无厌）。
entries.en: To grab money; to want everything, greedy.

entries.zh: 重利；贪图厚利（放债收重息）。
entries.en: Greedy for heavy profit; usurious, exacting high interest.
A measuring rule; the chi (Chinese foot) used to measure length.

entries.zh: 用手（肘至指尖）比量长度〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: To measure by hand or cubit 〔text damaged, gloss uncertain〕
entries.notes: M 栏有 que/re 异文，R 栏仅存 chiù heú chī，H「手後腳」与量度义不合，姑存疑。
H/M 两栏均空，仅 L 与残损 R 可读；L 疑即「codo del braço」（臂之尺）。

entries.en: Bribes; illicit gifts offered to officials.
entries.notes: R 栏 [疑:hi/lu]，取 lu 与「賂」相合。

entries.zh: 赃；官员受贿所得的赃款。
entries.en: Graft taken by a mandarin; official spoils.
A backhander; a kickback given covertly.

entries.zh: 暗中握手递钱（行贿时把钱包在掌中递过）。
entries.en: To slip a bribe into the hand in a handshake, pressing what the palm holds.

entries.zh: 后手钱；行贿的现钱（暗中给的回扣）。
entries.en: Bribe money; a cash kickback given covertly.
